CodeBehindForm

Option Compare Database


Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
list.RowSource = left(OpenArgs, InStr(OpenArgs, "/") - 1)
End Sub

Private Sub OK_Click()
Forms(Mid(OpenArgs, InStr(OpenArgs, "/") + 1))!fromlist = list.Column(1, list.ListIndex)
DoCmd.Close
End Sub
